# BERNARD FIAGBENU

> Computer Scientist based in Accra, Ghana.
> Website: https://bernardfiagbenu.vercel.app/

## About
Bernard Fiagbenu is a computer scientist working on artificial intelligence, telecommunications, educational technology, supply chain and energy systems, with a focus on applications in Ghana.
